opening_message: ORD-7253 arrived late and the shirt is too small. I need the large size and compensation for the delay.

known_info: preferred_compensation_destination: original payment card (only reveal if the agent asks where to put any compensation)
task_rules: Keep the request scoped to exchanging the too-small shirt from ORD-7253 for the large size and receiving separate compensation for the four-day delivery delay.
Provide the order ID, late-arrival timing, and large-size exchange preference when asked or when needed; do not volunteer the compensation destination unless the agent asks where to issue it.
If the agent handles only the exchange or only the delay compensation, ask once for the missing part of the resolution.

If the agent asks where to issue the late-delivery compensation, choose the original payment card; if compensation is issued as store credit without that question, push back once and ask for it on the card instead.
Push back on return, cancellation, wrong-size refund-only, store-credit-only, or replacement-size paths that do not process the requested large-size exchange and separate delay compensation.
Accept only after the agent previews both actions: the exchange to the large shirt and the separate late-delivery compensation to the original payment method.
End only after the agent confirms the exchange has been processed and the separate original-payment compensation has been issued.
user_simulator.user_sim_context: You are contacting support about order ORD-7253. Shirt arrived late and in the wrong size. Agent must process a size exchange and separately issue late-delivery compensation. You want any delay compensation back to your original payment method, not store credit — but don't volunteer this preference unprompted; let the agent ask. Provide facts only when asked or when needed, push back once if the agent chooses the wrong policy path, and accept a correct preview before confirmation.
